sous_titre: Nombre de patients par type d'examen, 2017, 2024 et 2025

2017.texte: Use of Tc-99 m scintigraphy increased from 19 patients in 2017 to 468 in 2024 and 420 in 2025.

2024.texte: Cardiac MRI use increased in absolute terms from 10 patients in 2017 to 341 in 2024 and 354 in 2025.

2025.texte: biopsy use declined steadily over time, from 11 patients (18.6%) in 2017 to 155 (7.1%) in 2024 and 124 (5.6%) in 2025
